name: @nexus/onboarding
description: Nexus Setup onboarding integration layer (EP-035 M3): real PostgreSQL 18.4 durable stores for owner bootstrap, deployment intent, enrollment tokens, integration state, and recovery checkpoints, plus real NATS JetStream event emission, bridging the @nexus/setup contracts to the canonical durable store and event bus. Provider-neutral boundary: contract semantics stay in @nexus/setup; this package owns transport only.
